name: TextStyleLevels
description: A collection of all the outline text levels. This collection always contains five members, each of which is represented by a TextStyleLevel object.
example:
With ActivePresentation.SlideMaster _
        .TextStyles(ppBodyStyle).Levels(1)
    With .Font
        .Name = "Arial"
        .Size = 36
    End With
End With

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single text style level from the specified TextStyleLevels collection.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: The index number of the text style level in the collection to be returned.
